existingProject: none supplied; no installed product version inferred
sourceArchive: payload-official/ (official docs, exact v3.88 source, release feed, npm tags)
coverageClaim: All target active files and sections inventoried. Result applies to explicitly stated source claims, not every example runtime. Unverified rows remain open and prohibit a full currentness/PASS claim.

technicalAspects.aspect: Runtime, channels, installed-version discovery and dependency compatibility
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Root asks for project version but carries no stable/prerelease dependency basis. Stable npm tag and latest GitHub release are 3.88.0; canary is 4.0.0-canary.33. Installation docs require Node 20.9+, package engine also admits ^18.20.2; this is not an app compatibility guarantee. Exact @payloadcms/next peers exclude Next 15.5 and require patched 15.x or >=16.2.6<17.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Record stable versus existing project, same-version @payloadcms packages, installed peers and adapters; no unrequested upgrade.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Version case preserves v2 while new v3 fixture rejects incompatible Next peer.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Source/generated root, Local API defaults, request threading and loop prevention
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Local API default overrideAccess=true is accurately warned; same req propagates request context/transaction and does not enable access checks by itself. Blanket atomicity requires adapter support and enabled transactions. Root transaction example lacks SQLite default qualification.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Preserve correct security rule; separate authorization and transaction propagation; state adapter prerequisite.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Actor request respects policy and injected nested write failure rolls back only when supported/enabled.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Collection CRUD access, Where return scope, admin entry and ordering
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Collection create accepts boolean, read/update/delete/readVersions can use Where; admin gates Admin Panel access. beforeOperation precedes executeAccess in exact create operation. End note contradicts its own table by limiting Where to collection read.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Publish exact operation matrix and distinguish Admin visibility from access enforcement.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Create returns Where must not count as tenant enforcement; update/delete Where remain permitted.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: RBAC/auth creation and roles privilege escalation
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Roles field protects update only; collection has auth but no create policy, so authenticated default creation can write admin role on a new user. API admission and field create must enforce privilege assignment.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Protect create and update for privileged fields; explicit first-admin bootstrap boundary.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Ordinary authenticated actor cannot create another admin or promote itself.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Reusable access, ownership, query composition, headers and field access
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Simple boolean/Where ownership and global/field distinction are supported. Field admin.hidden/condition is UI only. Optional id/user comparisons and header equality examples need actual identity/undefined handling; custom API key cannot infer missing env as authentication.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Keep valid patterns, explicit no-user guards; align field access argument availability and UI-only visibility.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Anonymous/undefined ids cannot satisfy owner rule; hidden field remains API-readable unless access denies it.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Tenant create and tenant field spoofing
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: tenantAccess returns a Where and is assigned create. Exact executeAccess rejects only falsy and create does not constrain data by that Where. Field hook fills tenant only if !value, preserving attacker-supplied other tenant.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Boolean create authorization and server-owned tenant assignment or explicit input equality validation; field create/update control.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Tenant A cannot create document for B even when supplying B id.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Auth self/admin, cross-collection count and arguments
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: count returns object {totalDocs}, but delete rule compares entire count result ===0. Hooks/access argument availability differs by operation; notes incorrectly say only collection read supports Where and all access runs before hooks.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Destructure totalDocs, preserve req, handle missing id/user; unify exact matrix.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Unreferenced record can delete; referenced record cannot; no undefined-id access lookup.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Context, tenant, user-agent, IP and time-based access examples
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Context and Date logic are ordinary app policy; forwarded headers and user-agent do not authenticate an actor. Listed CIDR strings are tested with exact string includes, not network containment. Exact IP allowlist cannot evaluate CIDR.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Use a declared trusted proxy identity boundary and real parsed IP ranges only when required; distinguish contextual hints from authorization.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Spoofed forwarded IP/user-agent cannot confer access; CIDR member and nonmember are evaluated accurately.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Subscription access, factory functions, configurations and diagnostics
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Several callbacks destructure req:{user} then reference req, so they throw ReferenceError. Application policies are illustrative rather than built-in Payload subscriptions.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Keep req object and derive user; type against Access; label app-supplied data/helpers.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Typecheck and invoke each retained callback with authenticated and missing user.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Access caching and per-query versus per-document performance
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Collection find evaluates collection read policy once for query, not once per returned document. FieldAccess lacks top-level context; use req.context. False cached results require presence check, not truthiness.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Remove incorrect N+1 claim, use actual request-scoped cache and arguments.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Multiple document result evaluates collection policy at query boundary; cached denial stays denial.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Mongo/Postgres/SQLite adapters, IDs and DB requirements
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Named mongooseAdapter/postgresAdapter/sqliteAdapter and connection configuration are present in current docs. Mongo transactions need replica set; SQL default ID shape differs from Mongo and uuid/uuidv7 branches.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Add installed adapter/engine evidence before inferring compatibility; v3.83 uuidv7 is optional, not mandatory update.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Load exact declared adapter configuration and verify chosen ID shape.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Automatic/manual transactions and migration CLI operations
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Same req and await are required for nested operations; overrideAccess=true does not remove transaction need. SQLite disables transactions by default; set transactionOptions:{} to enable. beginTransaction may return null without support. Migration up/down/status exist; reset/refresh/fresh are destructive paths.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Qualify atomicity, check transaction support, distinguish schema migrations and data imports; use installed declared CLI and explicit destructive boundary.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Force nested write failure and inspect persisted state; migration create/up/status on disposable DB only.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Storage: S3, R2, Azure, GCS, Vercel Blob and Payload Cloud
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Current standalone storage packages are correct family. R2 example supplies string bucket and S3 config; stable r2Storage requires Cloudflare R2Bucket binding. S3 credentials/endpoints belong to s3Storage branch. Remote availability is untested.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Replace R2 example with binding or explicit S3-compatible alternative; keep provider credentials/runtime requirements separate.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Exact R2 config typecheck; real provider readback required for remote claim.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Email adapter configuration and delivery boundary
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Official email documentation directly matches retained nodemailerAdapter transportOptions host/port/auth and resendAdapter apiKey/from fields. Full options examples were read. No delivery was attempted.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Preserve version-matched packages and provider boundary; do not infer delivery from sendEmail resolve.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Configured adapter loads; controlled provider delivery only within authorized environment.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Auth login, reset, custom strategies and API keys
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Login/forgotPassword and API-key-only options match current APIs. Strategy is not exported by payload 3.88.0; exact source exports AuthStrategyFunction/Args/Result. Auth callback must return a Payload user document or null; verifyToken is an unspecified application helper. Custom strategy changes require server restart.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Use exported AuthStrategyFunction or type auth.strategies through CollectionConfig; specify verifyToken trust contract and distinguish local token from browser cookie/session.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Login/session readback and invalid credentials; no token/cookie leaked in evidence.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Jobs tasks, workflows, inline API, worker execution and retries
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: job.runInlineTask does not exist in stable WorkflowHandler. Handler receives inlineTask and tasks; inlineTask(taskId,{task,input}) is supported. queue creates a pending job; a worker/run operation must process it. v3.71 added optional concurrency; v3.85 fixed no-retries loop.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Use exact stable handler API and document queue→run→terminal result; preserve idempotent step ids and failure distinction.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Task is queued, run, completes and output is visible; queued-only cannot pass.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Custom endpoints and default Local API privilege
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Featured collection endpoint invokes req.payload.find without overrideAccess:false; active detailed reference repeats that defect. PayloadRequest presence does not enforce caller permissions.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: All caller-scoped operations carry req and overrideAccess:false; explicit system operation requires actual task reason.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Anonymous and tenant actors receive only allowed records.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Custom React components and views
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Client component invokes useField without {path}; custom view imports server DefaultTemplate into client and omits required init props. File paths/import map and client/server split are required in v3.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Use typed field props/path and server view template; verify rendered Admin.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Generated import map resolves; custom field edits correct nested path; view renders.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Official plugins, localization and exported type reference list
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: plugin-search stores first-party indexed records; no built-in Algolia support claimed by official docs. Redirects plugin manages data and requires frontend redirect implementation. Import-export supports CSV and JSON with job runner requirements. Localization sample uses unimported TextField and buildConfig fragments lack db. main source links follow development branch rather than installed stable.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Fix plugin capability summaries, missing snippet imports/prerequisites; use tag/installed exports instead of main; distinguish configured redirects from observed HTTP redirect.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Each import/config resolves under locked versions; no fallback masquerades as translated field.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Basic/auth/upload collections and Globals
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Basic field/collection/upload config is supported, but auth roles are not guarded on create/update. Image resizing requires supplied sharp dependency in v3; collection examples alone are not complete buildConfig.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Guard privileged roles; mark schema fragments and complete required runtime dependencies where called runnable.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Actor cannot set admin role; upload creates a retrievable file.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Live preview, draft visibility and version status
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: _status stored values are draft/published; changed is UI state, not persisted enum. Draft enablement is not authorization: public read requires published filter. URL config alone is not frontend live-preview listener/rendering. Globals config/access supported.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Fix draft claims and distinguish preview URL from live-update end-to-end wiring.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Anonymous cannot read drafts; editor change appears in preview if live claim is made.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Endpoint request/response, paths, body parsing and helper signatures
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: v3 uses Web Request/Response and routeParams, no Express res/next. JSON/file body and locale helpers need awaiting and correct package exports. Actual request-specific CRUD examples omit overrideAccess:false.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Preserve current response/body patterns but bind all actor operations to access; avoid body double-consumption; verify helper export paths.
technicalAspects.falsifier: JSON/multipart and route params work; unauthorized request cannot perform CRUD.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Endpoint examples: custom search, upload, preview, placement and factories
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Real-world examples and best-practice claim that req.payload ensures access conflict with Local API default bypass. Authentication check alone is insufficient. OpenAPI comments are metadata, not installed API specification generation.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Correct every example and misleading best-practice line; mark application helpers/framework integration prerequisites.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Same actor input yields same allowed set as standard REST API; upload/publish deny cases covered.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Structural/capability/data/layout/tab/option guards and traversal
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Exact stable guard source differs from copied signatures: fieldSupportsMany includes upload runtime; fieldHasMaxDepth includes join; fieldAffectsData also admits virtual fields; optionsAreObjects checks first option only; fieldIsHiddenOrDisabled checks field.hidden/admin.disabled. Recursive traversal shown skips blocks and tabs.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Use installed exported guards and describe actual predicate; traverse all nested containers explicitly; do not claim persistence solely from name guard.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Mixed/nested schema visits fields inside blocks and named/unnamed tabs; guard examples match exact exports.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Text validation, experimental slug helper and Lexical features
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Custom text validate replaces default constraints; Boolean(value) does not preserve minLength/maxLength. slugField is experimental in stable source. EXPERIMENTAL_TableFeature needs explicit experimental boundary. Feature replacement must preserve intended defaults.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Wrap built-in validator or avoid redundant override; label experimental/version requirements and typecheck imports.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Short nonempty value fails declared minimum; optional experimental helper exists in exact version.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Relationships, arrays, blocks, select and upload shapes
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Single/hasMany/polymorphic relationship structures and corresponding config fields are supported. Storage uses returned Payload document IDs; population depth may return IDs or objects.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Preserve configured relationTo/cardinality; optional newer polymorphic uploads do not force changes.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Create/read representative single, multiple and polymorphic relationship with depth0 and depth1.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Point operators, joins, virtual fields and UI-only conditions
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Point data is [longitude,latitude]. near expects combined comma tuple; separate maxDistance/minDistance operator keys shown are invalid. SQLite geospatial query capability is limited. Join on collection relationship is supported; virtual fields not persisted, UI conditions not security.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Fix near syntax and adapter boundaries; preserve ownership/relationship source and virtual anti-claim.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Known inside/outside distance points filter correctly on supported adapter; virtual value absent from DB storage.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Radio/row/collapsible/UI/tabs/groups and field factories
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Field layouts and component paths are supported; custom deepMerge performs shallow spreads and can discard nested admin defaults. appearances argument is accepted but not used to restrict radio options.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Use accurately named shallow merge or real tested recursive merge; make accepted factory options affect output.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Factory override retains unrelated nested defaults and emitted appearance options equal input contract.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Hooks lifecycle, context and date auto-set
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Hook APIs/context are current. afterRead computes only output; beforeChange input is unvalidated and partial on update. Revalidation sample needs Next-specific cache API version grounding and failure propagation.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Bind hook phase, partial data/originalDoc, same req and loop guard; hand Next cache behavior to installed nextjs owner.
technicalAspects.falsifier: No loop; partial update preserves missing fields; failure does not produce false cache/data success.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Plugin packaging, exports, build commands and peers
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Plugin functions Config→Config/Promise supported. Example next^15.4.10 is incompatible with current patched peer minimum and admits excluded minors. SWC command correctly declares @swc/core but its referenced .swcrc is not supplied in the fragment. Example lacks graphql peer and does not establish exact package compatibility.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Use exact official template as version-scoped basis; verify declared build plus packed installed consumer import rather than isolated source compile.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Fresh plugin build/package install/import works against locked Payload fixture.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Plugin fields/hooks/endpoints/overrides/tabs/disabled behavior/i18n/onInit
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Composition should preserve existing config. onInit seed supplies string id seeded-by-plugin without custom ID schema; default SQL numeric IDs cannot accept it. Disabled-schema preservation is a deliberate plugin policy, not generic system default. Some overrides drop nested settings.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Use natural unique seed key and returned ID or explicit ID schema; preserve config/hook order; describe disabled plugin behavior.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Existing config/hook survives plugin; repeated init does not duplicate records; SQL seed succeeds.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Plugin TypeScript, client field, composition and async configuration
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Basic typed custom field useField({path}) is valid. Async plugin example may dereference optional config or append undefined; hooks map mutates collection.hooks without initializing it. Type/schema augmentation must match actual exports.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Typecheck complete retained fragments and invoke optional empty configuration; preserve existing config.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Plugin called with default/empty options and collections with no hooks returns valid config.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Plugin authorization/filter composition
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Wrapper puts original boolean/Promise directly in Where.and, so deny and async policy do not have defined correct composition. baseListFilter is deprecated and function typed, not static Where; filterOptions may static or async callback with full args, while example calls with relationTo string and undefined req.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Await original policy; false stays false, true becomes tenant filter, Where combines with tenant; use current baseFilter function and preserve filterOptions forms.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Original false denies; true/Where/Promise resolve correctly; no boolean/Promise is serialized into where.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Plugin admin metadata/providers/actions/views and recursive background work
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Arbitrary plugin metadata belongs to custom/admin.custom, not typed admin.meta; providers belong root admin.components, not collection. beforeFields is not current collection slot. Recursive resave requires pagination and req; omitted pagination reads first10 only.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Use actual typed slots, remove false From plugin attribution unless exact; iterate entire child set with cycle safeguards and transaction req.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Admin resolves components, metadata is available where intended, >10 children all processed without cycles.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Plugin dev fixture, Vitest/Playwright tests and package verification
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Test APIs describe optional integration/browser fixtures. Exact createPayloadRequest accepts Request and Promise<SanitizedConfig>, getPayload/destroy are present; Vitest test/expect and Playwright page/expect syntax is valid. vitest defaults to watch, one-shot requires run. Fixtures are fragments and source handler calls do not prove HTTP routing or packed consumer interoperability. Package-version compatibility remains P-T30; no command was executed.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Verify declared scripts/dependencies in safe fixture, keep current runner and installed-package boundary; no permanent harness required.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Declared commands run fresh fixture and packed import resolves; test process shuts down.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed

technicalAspects.aspect: Query operators, nested filters, Local/REST/GraphQL and pagination
technicalAspects.version: Payload 3.88.0 stable unless specified; installed project version must be established separately
technicalAspects.basis: Where/and/or/dotted fields and CRUD/REST/GraphQL shapes are documented. all operator is Mongo-only; depth has no GraphQL effect; defaultDepth2 and pagination10 apply outside GraphQL shape. req is needed for transaction even if overrideAccess=true, contrary to optional wording.
technicalAspects.requiredChange: Add operator/adapter limits, retain correct bypass warning and distinguish req transaction role.
technicalAspects.falsifier: Adapter-appropriate filters return expected set; totalDocs read as property; nested administrative write shares transaction.
technicalAspects.evidenceBoundary: Source/documentation review; code and agent execution not performed
